items.summary: Security review: needs owner decision before any public beta or full launch. Evidence confirms a password-gated private preview, but the supplied telemetry does not establish authentication strength, authorization boundaries, secret handling, container isolation, deployment controls, TLS posture, dependency risk, incident monitoring, or disclosure readiness. No credentials, secrets, production access, or exploit testing were used. Keep the current private posture and require an owner-approved pre-launch checklist covering access control, secret exposure review, release protection, TLS, dependency and supply-chain controls, data minimization, logging and incident response, and security.txt or equivalent disclosure contact before public exposure.

items.summary: Decide whether searchwoot.com should remain private preview or proceed toward a bounded public beta or full launch. No production change is requested.
items.requested_action: Owner: name the decision owner and choose keep-private, bounded public beta, or full launch. Before go-live, complete the legal, compliance, security, technical, data-rights, accuracy, privacy, consent, disclosure, attribution, contribution-margin, and rollback checklists. Security requires evidence for authentication and authorization boundaries, secret handling, container or runtime isolation, release and deploy controls, TLS, dependency and supply-chain controls, data minimization, incident monitoring, and a security.txt or equivalent disclosure contact. Consult human counsel on privacy, consumer-disclosure, data-rights, and platform-policy issues.
